def checkbox_lines(tasks):
    """Your team's standup bot posts a plain-text to-do list to the channel every
    morning, and you've been handed the tiny renderer behind it. Each element of
    tasks is a list [name(str), done(int, 0 or 1)]. The bot draws a small checkbox
    in front of every task so finished work is easy to spot at a glance. Return the
    lines '[x] <name>' for done == 1 and '[ ] <name>' for done == 0, in the given
    order, joined by the newline character chr(10), no trailing newline; return the
    empty string for empty tasks. That is all the formatting the channel supports,
    so the output should be exactly that shape and nothing more.

    >>> checkbox_lines([])
    ''
    >>> checkbox_lines([['a', 1]])
    '[x] a'
    """
